analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see decision maintained. RSI is sideways at 45.7 in the neutral zone, and the MACD histogram improvement continues to 1681.2376 but convergence with the signal line persists. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the 5-day low of 100,240 KRW being higher than the 20-day low of 82,710 KRW, but the volume ratio of 0.72 indicates contraction. ADX is at 21.1, in the early stages of trend formation.

analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — continued sideways range, wait-and-see conditions for directional confirmation.
